offering_description.value: Underwrites niche specialty property and casualty insurance, plus surety, for commercial and some personal clients. Sells mainly through wholesale brokers, retail agents and program partners, earning premiums and investment income.

primary_products.value: commercial property insurance; general liability insurance; commercial auto and transportation insurance; surety bonds; marine and professional liability insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, contractors, transportation firms and professionals needing specialty coverage; B2C: individuals buying personal umbrella and specialty personal coverages; B2G: public entities and contractors needing surety bonds

end_markets.value: commercial property; construction; transportation; professional services; surety

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums and investment income on the investment portfolio

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites and retains specialty insurance risk, sold via brokers and agents to businesses and individuals

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily United States, with limited Canada and international exposure

specialization.value: related lines: specialty property and casualty lines, marine, professional liability and surety under one underwriting model

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: wholesale brokers, retail agents and program administrators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance underwriting regulated by state insurance departments, with solvency and rate and form rules
